Thanks for telling me, Gideon. I'll keep this between us. I won't pass it to Ruth or Nadia or post it anywhere unless you ask me to, and I won't act on it.

Do you want me to do anything with it? For example, I could set a reminder ahead of the June renewal, or draft a note to Ruth and Nadia for you to review and send yourself. Since they're on the account, you may want to raise it with them directly.
